placement.derivation: Scripts/release_amah48_candidate.py rescaled all 2,633 architecture actors by RATIO = 48/50 = 0.96 about the world origin; Scripts/release_aron_alignment.py then translated the 2,917 temple actors by deltaCm [-248, 0, 0]. The composition is p_candidate = 0.96 * p_main50 + (-248, 0, 0). Evidence: SourceAssets/scale-review/amah48-candidate-20260908T144034771385Z.json and SourceAssets/scale-review/aron-alignment-release-Candidate48-20260908T220353291775Z.json. It is measured off the level itself by prove_placement() before anything is spawned.

offlineCheck.note: Every planned instance was re-tested against the Mount enclosure ring here, offline, before any engine was launched, and every hollow union decomposition was verified against the architecture manifest bounds.

limitations: Geometric placement only: no visual, collision, cook, performance or packaged acceptance is established.
Materials are created unassigned unless a material is already present at the expected path; assigning and tuning them is a separate reviewed step.

On Candidate48 the plants stand at IDENTICAL coordinates to Main50, because the FutureMountV1 terrain they grow out of was never rescaled by the 48 cm migration. What does change is the keep-out: the enclosure ring and the architecture blockers are tested in BOTH frames, so no instance lands inside either map interpretation of the Mount.
Geometric placement only. No visual, collision, cook or performance acceptance on Candidate48, and the species materials remain unassigned on both maps.

placementProof.method: every level actor whose mesh resolves to SourceAssets/architecture-manifest.json, compared with its manifest AABB carried through the declared placement, per axis, in centimetres; allowance 0.50 cm + 5.0e-05 of the axis span.
placementProof.usedFor: the Mount keep-out, not the instance coordinates

clearance.terrainNote: THE TRAP. The 256 terrain tiles are 400 m squares whose AABBs are 400-800 m tall boxes enclosing the whole Temple. They are the ground the plants stand on and are never blockers. The placer counts how many actors it skipped for this reason and records the count, so a rename cannot silently turn the exclusion back on and re-create the 100 per cent false-blocker result.
clearance.hollowUnionNote: Hollow derived-union meshes have AABBs spanning +-8100 XY and Z 300..3425 that enclose the entire outer court. They are decomposed into their constituent boxes from source_elements_json and the recomposition is verified against expectedBoundsUnrealCm before the boxes are trusted, exactly as release_place_assets.py does.

clearance.existingTreeNote: The 4265 retained illustrative OSM-derived trees are never touched. Their instance transforms are read numerically from the level and used as keep-out circles, which is a check only the editor can do because the offline generator has no access to their placed transforms.
clearance.mountEnclosureNote: No living plant inside the Mount enclosure ring or within the margin of it. Devarim 16:21. Every planned instance is re-tested against this ring in the editor before it is spawned, so a plan error cannot put a tree in the Azarah.
